versions.description: A yearly Secret Santa event for your community. Players sign up with santa join until the sign-up end date (default Dec 15). Then the names are drawn at random: everybody gets one other player, nobody draws themselves, and odd numbers work too. Each Santa sends an anonymous currency gift with santa gift <amount> [note] before the gift deadline (default Dec 24). The money is held until the reveal day (default Dec 25), when every receiver gets their gift and the server sees who was whose Santa. Daily PM reminders, sign-up broadcasts and a reminder on join. Admins can see the status, draw early, reveal early and reset. All dates are configurable.

commands.name: santa
commands.description: Secret Santa. santa = your status, santa join, santa leave, santa gift <amount> [note]. Admins: santa admin, santa pair, santa reveal, santa reset.
commands.helpText: santa = your status. santa join / santa leave = sign up or leave (before the draw). santa gift <amount> [note] = send your anonymous gift. Admins (SECRET_SANTA_MANAGE): santa admin, santa pair (draw now), santa reveal (reveal now), santa reset.

arguments.name: action
arguments.helpText: Empty for your status, or join, leave, gift, admin, pair, reveal, reset.

hooks.name: santa-connect
hooks.description: Reminds a joining player to sign up or send their gift, and tells receivers who were offline at the reveal about their gift.

cronJobs.name: santa-tick
cronJobs.description: Every 10 minutes: draw the names after sign-up ends, reveal on the reveal day, daily sign-up broadcast and gift reminders.

functions.name: santa-helpers

permissions.description: See the full status, draw the names early, reveal early and reset the event.
